controls.accepted_predicates: passed actual stage, two helpers,five single runs,two independent halves,two same-dt crosses,successful Debug Pre/Corr smoke; no nonzero-k/publicGPU/physical release accepted at base.

controls.canonical_program_runtime: Inherited from the retained time baseline canonical_GPU and old time isolated runtime entries. Canonical programs/runtime must remain unchanged; no canonical executable is overwritten.
